card.name: German places and addresses
card.fires_on: Punctuation, small linking words and number pieces right before a German or nearby place name, such as a city, region or postcode. It appears in German history texts and German contact details.

modes.label: Before German place names
modes.description: A comma or small word just ahead of a German region or city name.

modes.label: German address and phone numbers
modes.description: Digits, brackets or spaces inside a German postcode or +49 phone number.

modes.label: Historical region names
modes.description: Linking words or name pieces in German-region history, such as Aachen or Baden.

card.writes: It seems to push up German and European surnames and place-like names, and push down other place and brand names.
card.plain: It fires on the small words and digits just before a German place name or inside a German address or phone number.
